pluginMgr.title: Plugins
pluginMgr.description: Installed plugins, license status and the enable switch. Disabling closes the plugin's APIs and menu entry immediately; background jobs stop cleanly only after a restart.
pluginMgr.platformOnly: Only platform super administrators can manage plugins and licenses
pluginMgr.stopping: Waiting for previous workers to exit

toggle.label: Enabled
toggle.hint: Disabling closes this plugin's APIs and menu entry right away; established connections and background jobs only stop cleanly after a restart.
toggle.needRestartOn: Disabling it earlier stopped the background jobs, and enabling online cannot restart them: until the service restarts, this plugin's APIs and menu entry stay unavailable. Next step: restart the service.
toggle.needRestartOff: Background jobs got the cancel signal, but they only stop cleanly after a restart; enabling the plugin later needs a restart too.
toggle.configDisabled: Disabled by the disabled_plugins config, so this switch cannot turn it on. Next step: remove the id from the config and restart the service.
toggle.doneOn: {{name}} enabled: APIs and menu entry are back
toggle.doneOff: {{name}} disabled: APIs and menu entry are closed immediately
toggle.doneNeedRestart: {{name}} is set to enabled, but its background jobs only come back after a restart

license.tooLarge: File too large, please check it is a license file
license.needRestart: License imported, restart the service to apply

market.confirmRestart: This operation builds the frontend and backend and restarts the service, briefly interrupting access. Continue?
market.modifiedConfirm: These plugins have local changes or no installation baseline: {{names}}. Continuing backs up the source to data/plugins/backups before replacing the plugin directories; custom changes are not merged. Allow overwrite?

environment.ready: This node supports source installation and automatic restart
environment.unavailable: One-click installation is unavailable on this node
environment.failed: Environment check failed. Installation controls remain visible but unavailable; retry the check.
environment.guidance: Plugins ship as source, not hot-loadable binaries. For production, install and verify on a build machine, then deploy the artifacts. Installing here requires source, Go, npm, frontend dependencies and a service managed with start.

issue.dependencies: Frontend build dependencies are not installed.
issue.restart: This process is not managed with start, or its managed identity does not match; automatic restart is unavailable.

market.bundledNote: "Built-in" plugins are compiled into this binary and are listed here only to show version and license state: pro ones take a license from the card. To take a built-in plugin offline for a while (free ones too), use the enable switch on its card in the Installed tab (disabling closes its APIs and menu entry immediately; background jobs stop cleanly only after a restart). For a permanent switch use the disabled_plugins config, which wins over the toggle. Overwrite-install and uninstall edit the source tree, so the market does not offer them.

updateAll.confirm: {{count}} plugins have updates. All packages are downloaded and checked first, backed up and installed, then built and restarted once. Build failure restores source and the installation ledger, not the database. Start now?

upload.fileRequired: Pick a plugin package to upload

market.empty: Marketplace catalog is empty: register plugins in config/plugin-market.yaml to enable one-click installs
market.remove.confirm: Uninstall {{name}}? Source files will be removed and the service rebuilt (data tables are kept; use --purge on the CLI to drop them)

installLicense.title: Install {{name}}
installLicense.desc: Installing rebuilds and restarts the service. Pro plugins need a license: paste it now (offered for import when the service is back) or import later from the Installed tab
installLicense.placeholder: Paste the contents of the .lic file (optional, import later)

job.title: Working
job.desc: Download → install → rebuild → restart. Full log below; keep this page open
job.restarting: Service is restarting, waiting for a new instance…
job.restartTimeout: A new running instance has not been confirmed. Check service logs or restart manually; installation success is not confirmed.
job.requestFailed: Task status is unavailable, so the installation result is not confirmed. Check the connection and refresh to verify versions.
job.failed: Failed: check the log for details
job.freeNote: Free plugins need no license: they are ready once the build and restart finish.
job.proNote: Pro plugin: if it is still unlicensed after startup, import the license here; restart when prompted.
